data.name: Alam
data.gender_notes: Alam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Alam is an elegant Arabic name meaning 'world', 'universe', or 'flag/standard'. It represents someone who holds significance, spreads knowledge, or carries honor and identity. Common in poetry and spirituality. The name Alam carries the meaning “World, Universe, Flag” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Alam usually hope their child will grow to embody world, universe, flag and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a soul that carries meaning, purpose, or represents a noble idea in the world.
data.etymology: Alam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “World, Universe, Flag.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alam total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: عالم
in_arabic.meaning: العالم تعني الشخص الذي يعلم الكثير و هو عالم بالعلم و الحقيقة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العالم اسم مشتق من العلم و يعني الشخص الذي يعلم الكثير و هو عالم بالعلم و الحقيقة، و في القرآن الكريم، العالم هو الشخص الذي يمتلك العلم و الحكمة. و في التاريخ الإسلامي، كان العلماء هم الأشخاص الذين يمتلكون العلم و الحكمة و يستخدمونها لنشر الخير و الحق.

in_urdu.name: عالم
in_urdu.meaning: عالم کا مطلب ہے علم رکھنے والا، حقیقت کا جاننے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عالم نام علم کی دنیا سے نکلا ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے علم رکھنے والا، حقیقت کا جاننے والا۔ عربی جڑوں سے ملنے والے اس نام کا تعلق علم و حکمت سے ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء کی مسلم روایات میں، عالم نام علم و تقوی کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आलम
in_hindi.meaning: आलम का अर्थ है ज्ञानी, सच्चाई का जानने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: आलम नाम की उत्पत्ति विज्ञान और ज्ञान से हुई है। यह नाम ज्ञानी और सच्चाई के जानने वाले के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, आलम नाम की महत्वपूर्णता विज्ञान और ज्ञान के प्रसार में है।

in_pashto.name: عالم
in_pashto.meaning: عالم د علم لرونکی، د حقیقت پوهی
in_pashto.long_meaning: عالم نوم د علم او حکمت څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دا د علم لرونکی او حقیقت پوهی معنی لري. په افغان او پښتني دودیزو کې، عالم نوم د علم او دین د پوهانو لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Alam
in_english.meaning: Alam means knowledgeable, learned, or wise person
in_english.long_meaning: The name Alam originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'Alim,' which means knowledgeable or learned. In Islamic tradition, the name Alam signifies a person of knowledge and wisdom. Historically, scholars and learned individuals were referred to as Alam in Islamic societies. The name embodies spiritual significance, representing a person with deep understanding and insight into religious and worldly matters.

In various historical contexts, Alam served as the name of mosques, caliphs, and even flags, representing authority and sovereignty. In certain traditions, this name symbolizes the idea of universal wisdom and knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: In spiritual terms, Alam can be interpreted as a symbol of awareness and enlightenment. It encourages one to contemplate the grandeur of the universe and reflect upon their place within it. This name can be taken as a reminder of the divine wisdom and knowledge present in the world and the importance of seeking it. Additionally, Alam can be a reflection of one's personal spiritual journey and growth in understanding the divine presence in the universe and the self.
